machine_start_gcode.default_value:
;Machine Model: {machine_name}
;Nozzle Size: {machine_nozzle_size}
;Sliced at: {day} {date} {time}
;--- Penrose 600 IDEX Choosable (Filament) Start GCode ---
M140 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Heat build surface
M104 T1 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} 	;Heat nozzle
M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait for bed temperature
M109 T1 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait for nozzle temperature
G21 ;metric values
M107 ;fan off
G90 ;absolute positioning
G28 Z0 ;move Z to min endstops
G28 X0 Y0 ;move X/Y to min endstops
G1 X0 Y0 Z5 F5000 ;safety Z axis movement
G29 ;auto bed leveling
M500 ;save settings
M82 ;set extruder to absolute mode
M107 ;start with the fan off

; --- T1 Filament Purge (off-bed X=620 Y=-5) ---
T1 ;select tool 1
G0 X620 Y-5 Z5 F10000 ;move to T1 purge position
G0 Z3 F500 ;lower to purge height
G92 E0 ;reset extruder
G1 Y10 E5 F300 ;phase 1: Slow prime (5mm)
G1 Y25 E10 F500 ;phase 2: Medium purge (5mm)
G1 Y35 E15 F800 ;phase 3: Fast purge (5mm)
G92 E0 ;reset extruder
G0 Z5 F500 ;raise Z

G92 E0 ;zero the extruded length
M117 Printing...

machine_end_gcode.default_value:
;--- Penrose 600 IDEX Choosable (Filament) End GCode ---
M104 T1 S0 ;nozzle 1 heater off
M104 T0 S0 ;nozzle 0 heater off
M104 H0 S0 ;frame barrel heater off (defensive)
M140 S0 ;heated bed heater off
G91 ;relative positioning
G1 Z+0.5 E-5 Y+10 F12000 ;move Z up a bit and retract filament
G28 X0 Y0 ;move X/Y to home
M84 ;steppers off
M107 ;fan off
G90 ;absolute positioning
